_: synthetic tree for the hidden-leaf cases of test-draw-tree.sh. Residues are J and O, which are NOT amino-acid codes, so nothing here is WHO data. Every leaf carries the same sequence, so nothing is computed from the sequences; the two inode 'A' labels are the imported ones a .asr tjz would carry, and position 13 is the one under test. The inode with edge 9 is picked out by an edge_min hide mod: acmacs-tal hides its whole subtree (Node::hide) and then counts no leaves for it (Tree::set_first_last_next_node_id sums only non-hidden children), so its imported O13J flips its parent's J13O over 0 leaves and the parent keeps the label. Counting the hidden leaves instead puts the flip over the 0.5% threshold and the parent's label is dropped.
